end.summary:
Defined food miles as the distance food travels from its source.
Connected greater distance with more fuel use and emissions.
Suggested local, seasonal food as a way to reduce food miles.
Initially linked imported fruit with better taste and nutrition; later corrected the nutrition mix-up.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Rohan practised defining food miles, identifying fuel use, and suggesting local, seasonal foods to reduce travel distance. They used the method of linking a shorter journey with less petrol use. They initially mixed up imported food with better nutrition, then corrected this by explaining that distance does not determine whether food is healthy. At home, ask Rohan to compare two foods and explain which travelled farther and one limit of choosing local food.
